business_summary: China Railway Tielong Container Logistics Co., Ltd. provides railway transportation services in China and internationally. The company offers railway special container logistics services, such as transportation of steel, grain, ore, cement, cold and liquid chemicals, and other transportation services. It also offers railway freight, port logistics, warehousing, and freight forwarding services. In addition, the company is involved in real estate development activities, logistics and supply chain operations, and consulting services. China Railway Tielong Container Logistics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Dalian, China.
business_summary_ko: 중국철도철룡컨테이너물류유한회사(China Railway Tielong Container Logistics Co., Ltd.)는 중국 및 국제적으로 철도 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 철강, 곡물, 광석, 시멘트, 냉간 및 액체 화학물질 운송, 기타 운송 서비스 등 철도 특수 컨테이너 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 철도 화물, 항만 물류, 창고 보관 및 화물 운송 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 부동산 개발 활동, 물류 및 공급망 운영, 컨설팅 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 중국철도철룡컨테이너물류유한회사(China Railway Tielong Container Logistics Co., Ltd.)는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 대련에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
